lxc_c48fb55ddd0df536.text: Visit three famous European food markets in Barcelona, Paris and London.

lxc_5371b5ead89f1ead.text: Learn what you can find there, then practise the English you need to choose food, check ingredients, pay and tip.

lxc_d575fca47a3d34b4.text: La Boqueria is on La Rambla, a famous street in Barcelona.

lxc_5f361284845990f4.text: More than 200 traders work in the market.

lxc_95aa66a536658ab0.text: They sell fruit, vegetables, fish, meat, cheese, nuts, olives and other groceries.

lxc_ffb1c5e19f3d6495.text: There are also bars where visitors can eat.

lxc_dbdcce59cfa8c0d0.text: The many bright stalls make the market exciting, but it is useful to stop and look before buying.

lxc_c72d2742cdeebfc0.text: Common short questions are “What is popular here?”

lxc_c0000124887d0733.text: Some food is sold by weight.

lxc_cf166468f6cc1e0c.text: The order “Two hundred grams, please” gives an exact amount.

lxc_b433554f5b3d7482.text: Payment can be different at each stall, so “Do you take cards?”

lxc_c99bb558791a1fe3.text: You are in Borough Market Kitchen, the street-food area of Borough Market in London.

lxc_d740f5657b4fba55.text: The real market has more than 100 food businesses.

lxc_699254e8b047ff90.text: Tipping is different in Spain, France and the UK.

lxc_a6f4e1b199cbc8b6.text: In Spain, a tip is optional.

lxc_d6d746d5f94785bc.text: Some people round up the bill, but customers do not always add money.

lxc_5784198f7133ea34.text: In France, service is normally included in the restaurant price, so the question “Is service included?”

lxc_012b44d460a7d628.text: In the UK, the bill may show a discretionary or compulsory service charge.

lxc_7c359d7e31344b9b.text: The question “Is there a service charge?”

lxc_e81c5912a4e99022.text: makes an unclear bill easier to understand.
